changes.summary: Keep low-level window mechanisms in C and desktop policy in zl until the language/runtime can own the required structures safely.
changes.rationale: The current kernel zl subset cannot express the required window list and mechanism boundary.
changes.compatibility: No public ABI change; preserve the current C/zl boundary until the replacement language/runtime contract is proved.

changes.summary: Enforce clipping in all five back-buffer write paths by folding the scissor into loop bounds.
changes.rationale: Measured escape pixels refuted the two-function boundary without adding a per-pixel hot-path branch.
changes.compatibility: Rendering output must retain the five-path clipping oracle at every supported mode.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: Retire snapshot-and-sticker window dragging after damage repaint is authoritative; retain only cursor save-under.

changes.compatibility: Keep the existing drag fallback until retained damage repaint passes equivalent host and target gates.

changes.summary: Do not port a Linux-scale GPU stack; implement bounded native mechanisms while borrowing public hardware knowledge, not donor code.
changes.rationale: A complete i915/Mesa stack assumes kernel facilities outside zlOS, but bounded display/blitter providers remain valid product work.
changes.compatibility: Intel display/blitter work remains bounded native-provider work; Linux i915/Mesa ABI compatibility is not promised.
changes.evidence_ceiling: unreleased change candidate; not a published or runtime-complete release claim

changes.summary: All four kernel compiler routes consume one ordered kernel/SOURCES manifest.

changes.compatibility: Every kernel compile route must consume kernel/SOURCES; route-local source lists are unsupported.
